title: research: sharp P104 consumer threshold and six/seven/six caller format
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #3609 supplies an actual entrance completion, but its named consumer still fails and its arbitrary-grid caller format was unspecified. This focused package closes two local proof obligations without claiming a physical supplier or changing the selected frontier.

- **Sharp conditional budget.** For PR3609's actual full dual and the retained forward, every integer rank-unit deletion allowance at most 425 per dual fails for every integer pair count and every finite number of fully paid auxiliary banks in the named all-pair law. Strict convexity and outward rational intervals prove the all-pair statement. An abstract 426 rank-one deletion passes at seven pairs and a=1/596, but has only 4.557071360876949 total rank-normalised cost units of slack. Four added units pass; five fail. No deletion network is constructed. The full criterion includes replacement profiles, genuine coverage relief, and added cost.
- **Sharp six / seven / six format.** Arbitrary original-grid physical inputs need six added fractional bits for the 1,238-event entrance, seven for the 5,265-event exact execution, and six for all 358 final outputs. The proof combines Gaussian-ideal valuation, the exact scalar/frame trace, a literal 36-event necessity cone, and the required X0 endpoint. Sufficient stored and literal-scratch bounds are 3296H and 6592H, with signed widths b+20 and b+21 for the full word. This is one-layer refined ideal execution, not a coarse-grid rounded identity or all-depth theorem.

The calculator separately reproduces PR #3605's current T740 root bracket and PR #3574's 1126/1127 hosting separator. Their provider contracts are kept distinct from P104. Neither historical physical release is replayed here.

Package and proofs are in `research/p104-caller-feasibility/`. The remaining obligations are an actual producer, legal owners and writable/restored Y, zero stock, routing/control, a complete affordable invoice, and recursive admission. Unknown costs are not zero.

## Task and overlap

User-assigned continuation of the PR3609 handoffs, recorded as **changed** scope under the unchanged `p104-side-correction` card, priority revision 6. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19015413).

Frozen main and pre-submission fetch at 09:58 UTC remain `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. All checked guides and the selected record are unchanged. Entry coverage included all 330 open PR metadata/body records; the update-window refresh covered all eight PRs updated since 09:16, plus fresh P104/twiddle claims. Coverage excludes arbitrary historical diffs and all Discussion pagination.

Primary source is PR3609 at `13f974dae4af66027afb01f3ab42df9e830c2e90`; comparisons use PR3605 at `3efbb5de06a49ffeea6684482f2d3fe48cdca3fb` and PR3574 at `eb11cd484c23990c250bdc67ae61829ebae35536`. All 24 retained input files and source-specific notices are exact. Their public origins remain in the component manifests; this PR's source-retention ancestor makes clean-checkout provenance self-contained. No predecessor package is modified.

## Validation

Public head `5a4354c669dc05a9368f58321b1951ebac36d80d`, tree `f35c792cb220b130646e783310c4c1b128495c69`, changes only 39 files in this package. Local CPython 3.12.14 evidence includes registered normal/optimised commands, strict source/typed-receipt checks, disposable CLI mutations, and separate same-session proof and Git-free implementation review.

```sh
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-caller-feasibility
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-caller-feasibility --check-source-history
```

Exact public commit bytes and declared-source ancestry pass. Two official exports are identical, SHA256 `6318df0f60594c61778d474473687334a0f5de94abcfd44f346bbaf543a1455f`, 972,800 bytes. Actual Git-free normal, optimised, and CLI-control runs all pass; all 40 exported files, including the export receipt, preserve bytes and modes. Consumer and physical receipts are respectively `21183cc7bed0aacfcac41345a39382ac993175ea27c98b086d9b8f733ee192fe` and `9ce25af396a2f76a69f32409b3371e8a35ba4d912e9992535579ccfe4b7c3a0b`.

No historical full-native census, full selected replay, production physical caller, formal proof kernel, or independent human acceptance is claimed. Hosted CI will be reported only after its actual result.

## Credit

Credit Jose Manuel's consumer insight, Vasek's PR2744 audit, Nick Petalas's all-pair law and PR3462/3469/3416 lineage, Hiroki Kumazaki's projection, ywz65 and Arham Tahir's original physical inputs, the retained Newton/compiler/precision contributors, and Dumas and Grenet's earlier dirty-accumulation method. The stronger T740 construction remains Ross Richardson's work; PR3574 remains jwr's work with its native-channel and budget lineage. Detailed exact-source attribution and notices are retained.

Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance from a root agent and three concurrent specialists. New work is Apache-2.0. Same-session independent checks are described by their actual scope.

## Open next questions

`TASK.json` supplies the structured handoff. Reopen P104 construction only with a realised changed profile or genuine coverage change, its actual source/return contract, and a favourable whole bill. A named caller must meet the proved formats and pay every remaining owner/conversion/routing/return cost. A separate audit of PR3605's complete release is justified by its stronger arithmetic candidate, without transplanting it into P104.
